  <div class="rule"><b>③ 紧急警报</b><div><label>阈值 ℃</label><input id="f50a6-t3" type="number" min="50" max="85" value="75"></div><div><label>持续分钟</label><input id="f50a6-m3" type="number" min="1" max="60" value="1"></div></div>
 </div><div class="btns"><button class="primary" data-act="rules">保存三级报警阈值</button><button data-act="selftest">只读自检</button></div>
 <div class="line" style="margin-top:9px"><label>5分钟升温速度预警（℃/分钟）<input id="f50a6-rise" type="number" min="0.5" max="3" step="0.5" value="1" style="width:70px"></label><button data-act="rise">保存</button></div>

  <div class="btns"><button class="primary" data-act="notify">保存推送配置</button><button data-act="pushTest">发送微信测试消息</button></div>
   <div class="line" style="margin-top:11px"><label>每天推送前一日完整报告 <input type="checkbox" id="f50a6-reportOn" checked></label><label>每天几点 <select id="f50a6-hour"><option value="08">08:00</option><option value="09">09:00</option><option value="12">12:00</option><option value="20">20:00</option><option value="21">21:00</option><option value="22">22:00</option></select></label></div>
   <div class="hint">每日微信报告默认内嵌三张 SVG：温度24小时折线图、分时流量图、信号双轴图。无样本时显示原因，无需付费图床。请发送一次日报验证微信显示。</div>
  <div class="btns"><button data-act="reportSave">保存日报设置</button><button data-act="reportNow">立即推送带三图日报</button></div>
  <div class="btns"><button data-act="reportPreview">预览带三图日报</button><button data-act="syncCharts">刷新全部图表</button></div>
  <div id="f50a6-reportView" class="reportView" style="display:none"></div>
   <div class="hint" id="f50a6-pushstatus">推送设置待读取。即时警报只发简讯；每日日报默认包含表格和三张图，缺失样本会注明。</div>
 </div>
 <div class="hint" style="margin-top:13px">开源项目：<a href="https://github.com/PocketNetLab/f50-monitor-alert/issues" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color:#7cdacc">GitHub Issues · 反馈与联系维护者</a>。此插件非 UFI-TOOLS 官方组件。</div>
 <div class="card"><h3>运行与记录</h3><div class="btns"><button class="primary" data-act="install">一键安装 / 从旧版升级</button><button data-act="refresh">刷新状态</button><button data-act="probe">立即采集流量和信号</button><button data-act="health">设备健康统计</button><button data-act="signal">信号与温度关联</button><button data-act="export">导出温度 CSV</button><button data-act="exportSignal">导出信号 CSV</button><button data-act="diag">诊断信号/流量接口</button><button data-act="logs">查看日志</button><button data-act="stop">停止监测守护</button><button data-act="start">启动监测守护</button><button data-act="uninstall">卸载守护及数据</button></div>
  <pre id="f50a6-log">导入插件后，请先点击“一键安装”。</pre>
 </div>
 </div>`;document.body.appendChild(ov);
  const $=id=>document.getElementById('f50a6-'+id);
  const state={open:false,busy:false,timer:null,range:24,hist:[],flowHist:[],signHist:[],lastHist:0,lastExtras:0,lastHealth:0,rules:[],zone:'auto',lastProbe:0};
  const info=s=>{$('log').textContent=String(s);$('log').scrollTop=0;};
  const unwrap=x=>{
    if(x==null)return '';
    if(typeof x==='string'||typeof x==='number')return String(x);
    if(Array.isArray(x))return x.map(unwrap).join('\n');
    if(typeof x==='object'){
      if(x.success===false||x.code===401||x.code===403)throw Error('Root Shell 拒绝操作：'+JSON.stringify(x).slice(0,200));
      for(const k of ['stdout','output','content','result','data','message'])if(x[k]!=null){const s=unwrap(x[k]);if(s)return s;}
      return JSON.stringify(x);
    }
    return String(x);
  };
  async function root(cmd){
    const handler=typeof runShellWithRoot==='function'?runShellWithRoot:typeof window.runShellWithRoot==='function'?window.runShellWithRoot:null;
    if(!handler)throw Error('当前页面没有找到 UFI-TOOLS Root Shell 接口。');
    return unwrap(await handler(cmd+'\n'));
  }
  async function exec(op,...args){
    if(!/^[a-z_]+$/.test(op))throw Error('非法命令');
    const call='sh '+sq(BIN)+' '+op+args.map(a=>' '+sq(a)).join('');
    return root('if [ -f '+sq(BIN)+' ];then '+call+';else echo NOT_INSTALLED;fi');
  }
  const dt=s=>{const n=Number(s);return Number.isFinite(n)&&n>0?new Date(n*1000).toLocaleTimeString('zh-CN',{hour12:false}):'--';};
  const gb=b=>Number.isFinite(+b)&&+b>=0?(+b<10000000?(+b/1000000).toFixed(2)+' MB':(+b/1000000000).toFixed(2)+' GB'):'--';
  const temp=v=>Number.isFinite(+v)&&+v>0?(+v/1000).toFixed(1)+'℃':'--℃';
  const fields=s=>{const o={};for(const m of String(s).matchAll(/([A-Z0-9_]+)=([^\s]+)/g))o[m[1]]=m[2];return o;};
  const parse=s=>{const o=fields(s);const x=s.match(/(?:^|\n)OK\|(\d+)\|(\d+)\|(\d+)\|(\d+)\|(\d+)\|(\d+)/);if(x)o.live={time:+x[1],mc:+x[2],held:[+x[3],+x[4],+x[5]],tier:+x[6]};return o;};
  async function update(){
    let s=await exec('status');if(s.includes('NOT_INSTALLED')){$('state').textContent='尚未安装守护';return;}
    let d=parse(s);const monthParts=(d.FLOW||'').split('|');
    // The previous version only read the persisted file. An existing native counter was invisible
    // until the daemon eventually saved it. Probe once, and limit automatic retries to 2 minutes.
    if((!d.FLOW||d.FLOW==='NA'||!(Number(monthParts[1])>0)) && Date.now()-state.lastProbe>120000){
      state.lastProbe=Date.now();
      try {const liveProbe=await exec('probe_now'); if(liveProbe.includes('FLOW=')){s=liveProbe;d=parse(s);} }
      catch(e){console.warn('[F50] automatic flow probe failed',e);}
    }
    if(d.SAMPLE_AGE&&d.SAMPLE_AGE!=='NA'&&+d.SAMPLE_AGE>180){$('state').textContent='监测异常：温度采样 '+d.SAMPLE_AGE+' 秒未更新';$('state').style.color='#ffb86e';}
    else if(d.SAMPLE_AGE&&d.SAMPLE_AGE!=='NA'){$('state').style.color='';}
    const live=d.live;const ruleLine=s.match(/^THRESHOLDS=(.*)$/m);if(ruleLine)d.THRESHOLDS=ruleLine[1].trim();
    $('state').textContent=(d.RUNNING==='1'?'● 监测运行中':'● 监测已停止')+' / '+(d.BOOT==='1'?'开机自启':'未设置自启');
    $('temp').textContent=live?temp(live.mc):'--℃';$('temp').style.color=live&&live.mc>=75000?'#ff8991':live&&live.mc>=65000?'#ffb86e':'#93e8c1';
    if(live)$('state').textContent+=' · '+dt(live.time)+' · 第'+live.tier+'档';
    $('day').textContent='-- GB';$('month').textContent='-- GB';
    if(d.FLOW&&d.FLOW!=='NA'){const m=d.FLOW.split('|');if(m.length>=3){
      $('day').textContent=gb(m[0]);$('month').textContent=gb(m[1]);
      const src=m[2].startsWith('goform_')?'F50原厂计数变化量':m[2].startsWith('sysfs_')?'蜂窝网卡计数变化量':'未识别';
      const quality={OK:'连续采样',BASELINE:'首次基线',SOURCE_SWITCH:'切换计数源',COUNTER_RESET:'计数器重置',DAY_BOUNDARY:'跨日不追算',MONTH_BOUNDARY:'跨月重新计量',CLOCK_CHANGE:'系统时间变化',GAP_UNALLOCATED:'采样中断，流量不归入单个小时',UNAVAILABLE:'暂时不可用',NOT_STARTED:'尚未开始'}[d.FLOW_QUALITY]||d.FLOW_QUALITY||'未识别';
      const begin=d.FLOW_SINCE&&+d.FLOW_SINCE>0?new Date(+d.FLOW_SINCE*1000).toLocaleString('zh-CN'):'未知';
      const age=Number(d.FLOW_AGE)||0;
      $('flowSource').textContent='流量来源：'+src+' · '+quality+' · 统计起点 '+begin+(age>180?' · 已'+age+'秒未更新':'');
    }}else{$('flowSource').textContent='流量来源：暂不可用，请点击「立即采集流量和信号」';}
    $('flowRaw').textContent='原厂月度原始计数：'+(d.FLOW_RAW&&d.FLOW_RAW!=='NA'?gb(d.FLOW_RAW):'不可用')+'（仅供核对，原厂计数周期可能和日历月不同，不能直接与监控增量相加或比较）';
    $('rsrp').textContent='-- dBm';$('signal').textContent='RSRP/SINR：设备当前未提供可用数据';
    if(d.SIGNAL&&d.SIGNAL!=='NA'){
      const m=d.SIGNAL.split('|');if(m[1]&&m[1]!=='NA'){
        const rs=+m[1];$('rsrp').textContent=m[1]+' dBm';
        const grade=rs>=-85?'优秀':rs>=-95?'良好':rs>=-105?'一般':'较弱';
        $('signal').textContent='信号 '+grade+' · RSRP '+rs+' dBm · SINR '+(m[2]&&m[2]!=='NA'?m[2]+' dB':'不可用');
      }
    }
    if(d.ZONE)state.zone=d.ZONE;
    if(d.THRESHOLDS){
      const p=d.THRESHOLDS.split(/\s+/).map(Number);
      if(p.length===6&&p.every(Number.isFinite)){
        state.rules=p;
        for(let i=0;i<3;i++){$('t'+(i+1)).value=p[i*2]/1000;$('m'+(i+1)).value=p[i*2+1]/60;}
      }
    }
    if(Date.now()-state.lastHist>30000)await readHistory();
    if(Date.now()-state.lastExtras>60000)await readExtras();
    if(Date.now()-state.lastHealth>60000)await renderHealth();
    return d;
  }
  function canvasSetup(id,height=220){
    const cv=$(id);if(!cv)return null;const w=Math.max(240,cv.clientWidth||440),dpr=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);
    cv.width=Math.round(w*dpr);cv.height=Math.round(height*dpr);
    const c=cv.getContext('2d');c.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);c.fillStyle='#0c1b2d';c.fillRect(0,0,w,height);
    return {c,w,h:height,l:48,r:12,t:14,b:28,pw:w-60,ph:height-42};
  }
  function grid(c,g,lo,hi,suffix){
    c.font='11px sans-serif';c.textBaseline='middle';c.strokeStyle='#24405b';c.fillStyle='#8faac7';c.lineWidth=.7;
    for(let i=0;i<=4;i++){const yy=g.t+g.ph-i*g.ph/4;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(g.l,yy);c.lineTo(g.w-g.r,yy);c.stroke();c.fillText((lo+(hi-lo)*i/4).toFixed(suffix==='℃'?0:1)+suffix,3,yy);}
    c.textBaseline='alphabetic';
    // Hour labels are drawn by hourlyAxis() based on sample timestamps.
  }
  const hourName=ts=>String(new Date(ts*1000).getHours()).padStart(2,'0')+'点';
  function hourlyAxis(c,g,start,end,mode='rolling',rangeHours=24){
    c.save();c.fillStyle='#9ebad4';c.strokeStyle='#35516c';c.lineWidth=.75;
    c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='alphabetic';c.font='10px sans-serif';
    if(mode==='buckets'){
      for(let i=0;i<24;i++){
        const xx=g.l+(i+.5)*g.pw/24;
        c.beginPath();c.moveTo(xx,g.t+g.ph);c.lineTo(xx,g.t+g.ph+3);c.stroke();
        c.fillText(hourName(start+i*3600),xx,g.h-7);
      }
    }else{
      const step=rangeHours===1?600:3600;
      const first=Math.ceil(start/step)*step;
      for(let ts=first;ts<=end;ts+=step){
        const xx=g.l+(ts-start)/(end-start)*g.pw;
        if(xx<g.l+18||xx>g.w-g.r-18)continue;
        const d=new Date(ts*1000),label=rangeHours===1
          ? String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0')
          : hourName(ts);
        c.beginPath();c.moveTo(xx,g.t+g.ph);c.lineTo(xx,g.t+g.ph+3);c.stroke();
        c.fillText(label,xx,g.h-7);
      }
    }
    c.restore();
  }
  function drawChart(){
    $('tempTitle').textContent=state.range+'小时温度趋势';
    const g=canvasSetup('chart',220);if(!g)return;const {c,w,h,l,pw,t,ph}=g;g.range=state.range;
    const now=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000),begin=now-state.range*3600;
    hourlyAxis(c,g,begin,now,'rolling',state.range);
    const a=state.hist.filter(x=>x.time>=begin&&x.time<=now+120).sort((x,y)=>x.time-y.time);
    if(!a.length){c.fillStyle='#94aac5';c.font='12px sans-serif';c.fillText('暂无温度历史，启动守护后开始记录',16,110);$('average').textContent='暂无有效温度样本';return;}
    const vals=a.map(x=>x.mc/1000),max=Math.max(...vals),min=Math.min(...vals),avg=vals.reduce((v,x)=>v+x,0)/vals.length;
    $('average').textContent='最高 '+max.toFixed(1)+'℃ · 最低 '+min.toFixed(1)+'℃ · 均值 '+avg.toFixed(1)+'℃';
    let lo=Math.max(0,Math.floor(min/5)*5-5),hi=Math.ceil(max/5)*5+5;if(hi-lo<12)hi=lo+12;
    const x=s=>l+(s-begin)/(state.range*3600)*pw,y=v=>t+ph-(v-lo)/(hi-lo)*ph;
    grid(c,g,lo,hi,'℃');
    for(const [v,color] of [[65,'#eac75b'],[70,'#ef9761'],[75,'#ee687f']])if(v>=lo&&v<=hi){
      const yy=y(v);c.beginPath();c.strokeStyle=color;c.setLineDash([5,5]);c.lineWidth=1;c.moveTo(l,yy);c.lineTo(w-g.r,yy);c.stroke();c.setLineDash([]);
    }
    const pts=a.map(p=>({x:x(p.time),y:y(p.mc/1000)}));
    const path=()=>{c.beginPath();pts.forEach((p,i)=>i?c.lineTo(p.x,p.y):c.moveTo(p.x,p.y));};
    const fill=c.createLinearGradient(0,t,0,t+ph);fill.addColorStop(0,'#38d5be4d');fill.addColorStop(1,'#38d5be04');
    c.beginPath();pts.forEach((p,i)=>i?c.lineTo(p.x,p.y):c.moveTo(p.x,p.y));c.lineTo(pts[pts.length-1].x,t+ph);c.lineTo(pts[0].x,t+ph);c.closePath();c.fillStyle=fill;c.fill();
    path();c.strokeStyle='#67e6d3';c.lineWidth=2.3;c.lineJoin='round';c.shadowColor='#39d6c680';c.shadowBlur=7;c.stroke();c.shadowBlur=0;
    const marks=[[a.reduce((b,p)=>p.mc>b.mc?p:b,a[0]),'#f3ae5d'],[a.reduce((b,p)=>p.mc<b.mc?p:b,a[0]),'#6fb8ff'],[a[a.length-1],'#e9fefa']];
    for(const [p,color] of marks){const xx=x(p.time),yy=y(p.mc/1000);c.beginPath();c.arc(xx,yy,3.6,0,Math.PI*2);c.fillStyle=color;c.fill();}
  }
  function drawFlow(){
    const g=canvasSetup('flowChart',170);if(!g)return;const {c,l,pw,t,ph}=g;const now=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000),currentHour=Math.floor(now/3600)*3600,begin=currentHour-23*3600;
    hourlyAxis(c,g,begin,begin+86400,'buckets');
    const buckets=Array(24).fill(0),counts=Array(24).fill(0);
    for(const v of state.flowHist){const i=Math.floor((v.time-begin)/3600);if(i>=0&&i<24){buckets[i]+=v.delta/1048576;counts[i]++;}}
    if(!counts.some(Boolean)){c.fillStyle='#9aafc8';c.fillText('暂无分时流量，升级后开始累计',14,85);$('flowHint').textContent='尚无完整24h采样，不能追溯此前流量。';return;}
    const mx=Math.max(1,...buckets)*1.15;grid(c,g,0,mx,'');
    for(let i=0;i<24;i++){
      const barW=pw/24*.62,xx=l+(i+.5)*pw/24-barW/2,hh=buckets[i]/mx*ph;
      const grad=c.createLinearGradient(0,t+ph-hh,0,t+ph);grad.addColorStop(0,'#56bcf2');grad.addColorStop(1,'#1678b7');
      c.fillStyle=grad;c.fillRect(xx,t+ph-hh,barW,Math.max(1,hh));
    }
    $('flowHint').textContent='最近24h已采样 '+counts.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)+' 次；峰值小时约 '+Math.max(...buckets).toFixed(1)+' MB。';
  }
  function drawSignal(){
    const g=canvasSetup('signalChart',170);if(!g)return;const {c,l,pw,t,ph}=g;const now=Math.floor(Date.now()/1000),currentHour=Math.floor(now/3600)*3600,begin=currentHour-23*3600;
    hourlyAxis(c,g,begin,begin+86400,'buckets');
    const samples=state.signHist.filter(x=>x.time>=begin&&x.r!==null);
    if(!samples.length){c.fillStyle='#9aafc8';c.fillText('设备尚未提供有效蜂窝信号读数',14,85);$('signalHint').textContent='信号参数不支持时只显示不可用。';return;}
    grid(c,g,-140,-40,'');const fx=x=>l+(x.time-begin)/86400*pw,fy=v=>t+ph-((v+140)/100)*ph;
    c.beginPath();samples.forEach((v,i)=>i?c.lineTo(fx(v),fy(v.r)):c.moveTo(fx(v),fy(v.r)));c.strokeStyle='#56aee8';c.lineWidth=2;c.stroke();
    const withSinr=samples.filter(x=>x.sinr!==null);
    if(withSinr.length){c.beginPath();withSinr.forEach((v,i)=>i?c.lineTo(fx(v),t+ph-(v.sinr+10)/50*ph):c.moveTo(fx(v),t+ph-(v.sinr+10)/50*ph));c.strokeStyle='#f3b86b';c.lineWidth=1.8;c.stroke();
      c.fillStyle='#e7bb80';c.textAlign='right';c.font='10px sans-serif';for(let k=0;k<3;k++){const yy=t+ph-k*ph/2;c.fillText((-10+k*25)+'',g.w-3,yy);}c.textAlign='left';}
    const avg=samples.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.r,0)/samples.length,weak=samples.filter(x=>x.r<=-105).length;
    const avgSinr=withSinr.length?(withSinr.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.sinr,0)/withSinr.length).toFixed(1)+' dB':'不可用';
    $('signalHint').textContent='蓝=RSRP '+avg.toFixed(1)+' dBm · 橙=SINR '+avgSinr+' · 弱信号 '+weak+'/'+samples.length;
  }
  async function readExtras(){
    const [f,s]=await Promise.all([exec('flow_history'),exec('signals')]);
    state.flowHist=[];for(const line of f.split(/\r?\n/)){const m=line.match(/^(\d{10,11})\|(\d+)\|(\d+)\|(\d+)$/);if(m)state.flowHist.push({time:+m[1],delta:+m[2]});}
    state.signHist=[];for(const line of s.split(/\r?\n/)){const m=line.match(/^(\d{10,11})\|(NA|-?\d+)\|(NA|-?\d+)\|(\d+)$/);if(m)state.signHist.push({time:+m[1],r:m[2]==='NA'?null:+m[2],sinr:m[3]==='NA'?null:+m[3],temp:+m[4]});}
    state.lastExtras=Date.now();drawFlow();drawSignal();
  }
  async function renderHealth(){
    const s=await exec('health');const part=s.split('YESTERDAY')[0],m=fields(part);
    $('maxTemp').textContent=m.MAX?m.MAX+'℃':'--℃';$('avgTemp').textContent=m.AVG?m.AVG+'℃':'--℃';
    $('over65').textContent=m.OVER65?Math.floor(+m.OVER65/60)+' 分钟':'-- 分钟';
    $('weak').textContent=m.WEAK?m.WEAK+' / '+(m.SIGNALN||'0'):'--';state.lastHealth=Date.now();
  }
  async function readHistory(){
    const s=await exec('history');state.hist=[];
    for(const line of s.split(/\r?\n/)){const m=line.match(/^(\d{10,11})\|(\d{4,6})$/);if(m){const mc=+m[2];if(mc>=15000&&mc<=105000)state.hist.push({time:+m[1],mc});}}
    state.lastHist=Date.now();drawChart();
  }
  async function scan(){
    const s=await exec('scan');const select=$('zone');select.replaceChildren();
    const a=document.createElement('option');a.value='auto';a.textContent='自动：最高有效温区（仅参考）';select.appendChild(a);
    let n=0;for(const line of s.split(/\r?\n/)){const m=line.match(/^(thermal_zone\d+)\|([^|]*)\|(\d+)$/);if(!m)continue;
      const op=document.createElement('option');op.value=m[1];op.textContent=m[1]+' · '+m[2]+' · '+temp(m[3]);select.appendChild(op);n++;}
    select.value=state.zone;info('识别到 '+n+' 个有效温区。请核对与原后台温度的对应关系。');
  }
  async function saveRules(){
    const r=[];for(let i=1;i<=3;i++){r.push(Number($('t'+i).value),Number($('m'+i).value));}
    if(!r.every(Number.isInteger)||!(r[0]>=50&&r[4]<=85&&r[0]<r[2]&&r[2]<r[4])||[r[1],r[3],r[5]].some(x=>x<1||x>60))throw Error('温度请依次递增50–85℃，持续时间1–60分钟。');
    const s=await exec('rules',...r.map(String));if(!s.includes('RULES_SAVED'))throw Error(s);info('已保存只读温度报警阈值，不涉及关机和断网。');await update();
  }
  async function deploy(){
    const check=await root('if [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] && command -v base64 >/dev/null 2>&1;then echo ROOT_OK;else echo ROOT_FAIL;fi');
    if(!check.includes('ROOT_OK'))throw Error('未获得Root Shell或base64不可用。');
    // Preserve the previous script for manual recovery; NEVER delete telemetry during upgrades.
    await root('if [ -f '+sq(BIN)+' ];then cp -p '+sq(BIN)+' '+sq(BIN+'.previous')+' 2>/dev/null || true;fi; echo BACKUP_CHECKED');
    // Stop active v6/v6.1 daemon before replacing script; otherwise an old shell stays in memory.
    await root('if [ -f '+sq(BIN)+' ];then sh '+sq(BIN)+' stop >/dev/null 2>&1;fi; echo PREVIOUS_STOPPED');
    // Stop old v5.1 daemon and remove its boot hook. Old stop may restore data it previously disabled.
    const old='/data/local/tmp/f50_thermal_guard/guard.sh';
    const previous=await root('if [ -f '+sq(old)+' ];then sh '+sq(old)+' stop;else echo OLD_ABSENT;fi; if [ -f '+sq(BIN)+' ];then sh '+sq(BIN)+' stop;fi; sleep 2; echo OLD_STOPPED');
    info('已处理旧版后台：'+previous.slice(0,130)+'\n开始部署新版只读监控。');
    const ready=await root('mkdir -p '+sq(BASE)+' && : > '+sq(BASE+'/stage.b64')+' && echo STAGE_OK');
    if(!ready.includes('STAGE_OK'))throw Error('创建暂存文件失败。');
    const parts=PAYLOAD.match(/.{1,2300}/g)||[];
    for(const part of parts){const s=await root('printf %s '+sq(part)+' >> '+sq(BASE+'/stage.b64')+' && echo WRITE_OK');if(!s.includes('WRITE_OK'))throw Error('传输守护脚本不完整。');}
    const build='base64 -d '+sq(BASE+'/stage.b64')+' > '+sq(BASE+'/monitor.new')+
      ' && [ "$(wc -c < '+sq(BASE+'/monitor.new')+')" -eq '+EXPECTED+' ] && sh -n '+sq(BASE+'/monitor.new')+
      ' && mv '+sq(BASE+'/monitor.new')+' '+sq(BIN)+' && chmod 700 '+sq(BIN)+' && rm -f '+sq(BASE+'/stage.b64')+' && echo DEPLOY_OK';
    const out=await root(build);if(!out.includes('DEPLOY_OK'))throw Error('设备端校验失败：'+out);
    // Keep already configured zone/thresholds/PushPlus token, if new installation has no settings yet.
    await root('OLD=/data/local/tmp/f50_thermal_guard; NEW='+sq(BASE)+'; '+
      'if [ -r "$OLD/zone" ] && [ "$(cat "$NEW/zone" 2>/dev/null)" = auto ];then z=$(cat "$OLD/zone");case "$z" in thermal_zone[0-9]*) [ -r "/sys/class/thermal/$z/temp" ] && printf %s "$z" > "$NEW/zone";;esac;fi; '+
      'if [ -r "$OLD/rules" ] && [ "$(cat "$NEW/thresholds" 2>/dev/null)" = "65000 600 70000 180 75000 60" ];then cut -d " " -f 1-6 "$OLD/rules" > "$NEW/thresholds";fi; '+
      'if [ ! -s "$NEW/push.token" ] && [ -s "$OLD/pushplus.token" ];then cp "$OLD/pushplus.token" "$NEW/push.token";chmod 600 "$NEW/push.token";cp "$OLD/push_on" "$NEW/push.on" 2>/dev/null || true;fi; '+
      'if [ -r "$OLD/rise_limit" ];then cp "$OLD/rise_limit" "$NEW/rise.milli_per_min";fi;echo MIGRATED');
    let test=await exec('selftest');
    if(!test.includes('SELFTEST_OK')){await root('echo '+sq('65000 600 70000 180 75000 60')+' > '+sq(BASE+'/thresholds'));test=await exec('selftest');}
    if(!test.includes('SELFTEST_OK'))throw Error('自检未通过：'+test);
    const start=await exec('start');if(!/STARTED|ALREADY_RUNNING/.test(start))throw Error('监测启动失败：'+start);
    const hook=await exec('boot');
    info('升级完成。'+start+' / '+hook+'\n已停止旧版降载守护；新版仅采集数据和推送，不会关机、断网。');
    await update();await scan();await loadNotify();await readExtras();
  }
  async function notifySave(){
    const tok=$('token').value.trim(),on=$('push').checked?'1':'0';
    if(tok&&!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,256}$/.test(tok))throw Error('Token只能包含字母、数字、下划线和短横线。');
    const s=await exec('notify_config',on,tok||'KEEP');if(!s.includes('PUSH_SAVED'))throw Error(s);
    $('token').value='';info('微信推送配置已保存。');await loadNotify();
  }
  async function loadNotify(){
    const s=await exec('notify_status');if(s.includes('NOT_INSTALLED'))return;
    const d=fields(s);$('push').checked=d.PUSH==='ON';$('reportOn').checked=d.REPORT_ON==='1';
    if(d.REPORT_HOUR){$('hour').value=d.REPORT_HOUR;}
    if(d.RISE_LIMIT){$('rise').value=(+d.RISE_LIMIT/1000).toFixed(1);}
    $('pushstatus').textContent='微信推送：'+(d.PUSH==='ON'?'已开启':'关闭')+' · Token '+(d.TOKEN==='SET'?'已设置':'未设置')+' · 待发 '+(d.QUEUE||'0')+' 条 · 内嵌温度/流量/信号图默认开启。接口接收不代表微信送达。';
  }
  async function signalAnalysis(){
    const s=await exec('signals');state.signHist=[];
    for(const line of s.split(/\r?\n/)){const m=line.match(/^(\d{10,11})\|(NA|-?\d+)\|(NA|-?\d+)\|(\d+)$/);if(m)state.signHist.push({time:+m[1],r:m[2]==='NA'?null:+m[2],sinr:m[3]==='NA'?null:+m[3],temp:+m[4]});}
    const a=state.signHist.filter(x=>x.r!==null&&x.temp>0),weak=a.filter(x=>x.r<=-105),strong=a.filter(x=>x.r>-105);
    const avg=arr=>arr.length?(arr.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.temp,0)/arr.length/1000).toFixed(1)+'℃':'无样本';
    info('近24小时信号样本 '+a.length+' 个\n弱信号 RSRP≤-105 dBm：'+weak.length+' 个，平均温度 '+avg(weak)+'\n较强信号：'+strong.length+' 个，平均温度 '+avg(strong)+'\n仅表示观察到的相关性，不代表信号差一定造成发热。');
  }
  function saveCsv(name,cols,rows){
    const blob=new Blob(['\ufeff'+cols+'\n'+rows.join('\n')],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8'}),u=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=u;a.download=name;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),3000);
  }
  const actions={
    install:deploy,refresh:async()=>{state.lastProbe=0;await update();await loadNotify();info('设备状态已刷新。流量来源：'+$('flowSource').textContent);},
    probe:async()=>{const s=await exec('probe_now');state.lastProbe=Date.now();await update();await loadNotify();info('实时接口采集结果：\n'+s.replace(/^OK\|.*$/m,'[温度样本已读取]').slice(0,1100));},scan,
    zone:async()=>{const s=await exec('zone',$('zone').value);if(!s.includes('ZONE_SAVED'))throw Error(s);state.zone=$('zone').value;info('温区已保存，后台下一次采样生效。');},
    rules:saveRules,selftest:async()=>info(await exec('selftest')),
    rise:async()=>{const v=+$('rise').value;if(!(v>=.5&&v<=3&&Number.isInteger(v*2)))throw Error('升温阈值请设置0.5–3.0℃/分钟');const s=await exec('rise',String(v*1000));info(s);},
    notify:notifySave,pushTest:async()=>{const s=await exec('notify_test');info(s.includes('API_ACCEPTED')?'PushPlus 接口已接收测试。请到微信确认实际送达。':s);},
    reportSave:async()=>{const s=await exec('report_config',$('reportOn').checked?'1':'0',$('hour').value);info(s);await loadNotify();},
    reportNow:async()=>info('日报提交：'+await exec('report_now')+'\n日报图表使用内嵌SVG；请在微信中检查显示情况。'),
    syncCharts:async()=>{state.lastHist=0;state.lastExtras=0;await readHistory();await readExtras();info('温度、流量、信号三张趋势图已刷新。');},
    reportPreview:async()=>{const s=await exec('report_preview');if(!s.includes('F50 每日健康报告'))throw Error('暂时没有足够的当日采样，无法预览。');const target=$('reportView');target.innerHTML=s.slice(s.indexOf('<div'));target.style.display='block';info('已生成当前日报预览，向下查看。');},
    health:async()=>info('设备健康统计：\n'+await exec('health')),
    signal:signalAnalysis,
    diag:async()=>info('F50 接口诊断（不包含SIM/设备身份信息）：\n'+await exec('diag')),
    logs:async()=>info(await exec('logs')),
    export:async()=>{await readHistory();saveCsv('F50_temperature_'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.csv','timestamp,temperature_c',state.hist.map(x=>new Date(x.time*1000).toISOString()+','+(x.mc/1000).toFixed(2)));info('已导出温度历史记录 '+state.hist.length+' 条。');},
    exportSignal:async()=>{await signalAnalysis();saveCsv('F50_signal_'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.csv','timestamp,rsrp_dbm,sinr_db,temperature_c',state.signHist.map(x=>new Date(x.time*1000).toISOString()+','+(x.r??'')+','+(x.sinr??'')+','+(x.temp/1000).toFixed(2)));info('已导出信号记录 '+state.signHist.length+' 条。');},
    stop:async()=>{if(!confirm('确认停止监测？停止后不会自动发送温度警报或日报。'))return;info(await exec('stop'));await update();},
    start:async()=>{info((await exec('start'))+'\n'+(await exec('boot')));await update();},
    uninstall:async()=>{if(!confirm('确认卸载新版守护及其历史记录？无法恢复。'))return;info(await exec('uninstall'));state.hist=[];drawChart();await update();}
  };
  async function act(name){if(state.busy)return;state.busy=true;const buttons=ov.querySelectorAll('button[data-act]');buttons.forEach(b=>b.disabled=true);try{await actions[name]();}catch(e){info('操作失败：'+(e&&e.message?e.message:String(e)));}finally{state.busy=false;buttons.forEach(b=>b.disabled=false);}}
  ov.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button[data-act]');if(b){act(b.dataset.act);return;}if(e.target===ov)close();});
  ov.querySelectorAll('button[data-range]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.range=+b.dataset.range;drawChart();}));
  function close(){ov.style.display='none';state.open=false;if(state.timer)clearInterval(state.timer);state.timer=null;}
  $('close').onclick=close;
  launch.onclick=async()=>{ov.style.display='flex';state.open=true;try{await update();await loadNotify();await scan();}catch(e){info('读取失败：'+e.message);}if(state.timer)clearInterval(state.timer);state.timer=setInterval(async()=>{if(!state.open||state.busy)return;try{await update();}catch(e){console.warn('[F50 alert v6]',e);}},20000);};
  console.log('[F50 Alert v1.0.1] UI loaded, monitor-only; matched flow baselines.');
}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',initF50MonitorV6,{once:true});else initF50MonitorV6();
})();
</script>
